verdict.rationale: Unity ships multiple official, documented SDK-like surfaces relevant to AI-native building: a public scripting API for direct engine control, an official MCP server connecting LLM agents (Claude Code, Cursor) to the Editor, a CLI for automation/CI, and Sentis, a first-party neural-network inference SDK for embedding models in-app. These are independently confirmed via docs and a live probe of the MCP get-started page and CLI docs.  missing for 10: independent/hands-on developer corroboration of building against these SDKs (only vendor docs/probes cited), and no explicit third-party validation of the MCP server or Sentis in practice.
